--!strict

-- Pure camera-local geometry and motion. No Instances, input hooks or gameplay.
local Flashlight = { MaxParts = 14, NearClearance = 0.65 }
local cf, v3 = CFrame.new, Vector3.new
local TAU = 2 * math.pi
local SETTINGS = table.freeze({
	WalkSpeed = 12,
	WalkCadence = 1.7,
	MaxCadence = 2.1,
	MaxSprintScale = 1.35,
	MotionRate = 8,
	AimRate = 14,
	AimLimit = math.rad(2),
	MaxDt = 0.25,
	TeleportSpeed = 64,
	Lights = table.freeze({
		main = table.freeze({ range = 64, angle = 48, brightness = 3, shadows = true }),
		fill = table.freeze({ range = 18, angle = 80, brightness = 0.35, shadows = false }),
	}),
})
Flashlight.Settings = SETTINGS
Flashlight.LensFrame = cf(0, 0, -0.442)

type Definition = {
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	localFrame: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	shape: Enum.PartType,
	isHand: boolean,
}
local definitions: { Definition } = {}
local function add(
	name: string,
	size: Vector3,
	frame: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	isHand: boolean?
)
	table.insert(
		definitions,
		table.freeze({
			name = name,
			size = size,
			localFrame = frame,
			color = color,
			material = material,
			shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block,
			isHand = isHand == true,
		})
	)
end
local dark, black, rim =
	Color3.fromRGB(27, 29, 31), Color3.fromRGB(12, 14, 16), Color3.fromRGB(65, 69, 73)
local cylinder = CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
add(
	"Body",
	v3(0.62, 0.18, 0.18),
	cf(0, 0, 0.08) * cylinder,
	dark,
	Enum.Material.Metal,
	Enum.PartType.Cylinder
)
add(
	"Head",
	v3(0.2, 0.25, 0.25),
	cf(0, 0, -0.31) * cylinder,
	black,
	Enum.Material.Metal,
	Enum.PartType.Cylinder
)
add(
	"Rim",
	v3(0.045, 0.27, 0.27),
	cf(0, 0, -0.4) * cylinder,
	rim,
	Enum.Material.Metal,
	Enum.PartType.Cylinder
)
add(
	"Lens",
	v3(0.018, 0.218, 0.218),
	cf(0, 0, -0.433) * cylinder,
	Color3.fromRGB(225, 232, 238),
	Enum.Material.Glass,
	Enum.PartType.Cylinder
)
add(
	"BackCap",
	v3(0.055, 0.195, 0.195),
	cf(0, 0, 0.417) * cylinder,
	black,
	Enum.Material.Metal,
	Enum.PartType.Cylinder
)
for index = 1, 3 do
	add(
		"GripRing" .. index,
		v3(0.035, 0.194, 0.194),
		cf(0, 0, 0.04 + index * 0.09) * cylinder,
		black,
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	)
end
add("Switch", v3(0.075, 0.025, 0.1), cf(0, 0.1, -0.03), black, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
local skin = Color3.fromRGB(197, 151, 113)
add(
	"LeftPalm",
	v3(0.245, 0.235, 0.27),
	cf(-0.035, -0.12, 0.22),
	skin,
	Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
	nil,
	true
)
add(
	"LeftThumb",
	v3(0.095, 0.175, 0.16),
	cf(0.105, -0.038, 0.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-18)),
	skin,
	Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
	nil,
	true
)
table.freeze(definitions)

function Flashlight.Definitions(): { Definition }
	return definitions
end

type MotionState = {
	phase: number,
	idlePhase: number,
	travelSpeed: number,
	weight: number,
	lagPitch: number,
	lagYaw: number,
}
type Output = { view: CFrame, aim: CFrame, camera: CFrame, bobWeight: number }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end
local function number(value: any, fallback: number): number
	return if finite(value) then value else fallback
end

function Flashlight.NewState(): MotionState
	return table.freeze({
		phase = 0,
		idlePhase = 0,
		travelSpeed = 0,
		weight = 0,
		lagPitch = 0,
		lagYaw = 0,
	})
end

function Flashlight.Step(previous: any, delta: any, supplied: any): (MotionState, Output)
	local old = if type(previous) == "table" then previous else Flashlight.NewState()
	local input = if type(supplied) == "table" then supplied else {}
	local dt = if finite(delta) then math.clamp(delta, 0, SETTINGS.MaxDt) else 0
	local speed = math.max(number(input.speed, 0), 0)
	local reset = input.teleported == true
		or speed > SETTINGS.TeleportSpeed
		or not finite(delta)
		or (finite(delta) and delta > SETTINGS.MaxDt)
		or (input.speed ~= nil and not finite(input.speed))
	local phase = number(old.phase, 0) % TAU
	local idlePhase = (number(old.idlePhase, 0) + dt * TAU * 0.24) % TAU
	local travelSpeed =
		math.clamp(number(old.travelSpeed, 0), 0, 12 * SETTINGS.MaxCadence / SETTINGS.WalkCadence)
	local weight = math.clamp(number(old.weight, 0), 0, SETTINGS.MaxSprintScale)
	local lagPitch = math.clamp(number(old.lagPitch, 0), -SETTINGS.AimLimit, SETTINGS.AimLimit)
	local lagYaw = math.clamp(number(old.lagYaw, 0), -SETTINGS.AimLimit, SETTINGS.AimLimit)
	if reset then
		phase, travelSpeed, weight, lagPitch, lagYaw = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		speed = 0
	end
	local movingSpeed = if input.grounded == true then speed else 0
	local cadenceTarget =
		math.min(movingSpeed, SETTINGS.WalkSpeed * SETTINGS.MaxCadence / SETTINGS.WalkCadence)
	local sprint = math.clamp((movingSpeed - SETTINGS.WalkSpeed) / 6, 0, 1)
	local weightTarget = math.clamp(movingSpeed / SETTINGS.WalkSpeed, 0, 1)
		* (1 + (SETTINGS.MaxSprintScale - 1) * sprint)
	local decay = math.exp(-SETTINGS.MotionRate * dt)
	-- Exact integration of the filtered speed avoids FPS-dependent gait phase.
	local travelled = cadenceTarget * dt
		+ (travelSpeed - cadenceTarget) * (1 - decay) / SETTINGS.MotionRate
	phase = (phase + travelled * TAU * SETTINGS.WalkCadence / SETTINGS.WalkSpeed) % TAU
	travelSpeed = cadenceTarget + (travelSpeed - cadenceTarget) * decay
	weight = weightTarget + (weight - weightTarget) * decay
	local turn = input.turn
	local turnValid = typeof(turn) == "Vector2" and finite(turn.X) and finite(turn.Y)
	if dt > 0 and not reset then
		local turnPitch = if turnValid then math.clamp(turn.X, -math.pi, math.pi) else 0
		local turnYaw = if turnValid then math.clamp(turn.Y, -math.pi, math.pi) else 0
		local aimDecay = math.exp(-SETTINGS.AimRate * dt)
		-- turn is a camera angular displacement in radians for this frame. This
		-- is the exact first-order lag for constant angular velocity over dt.
		local follow = (1 - aimDecay) / (SETTINGS.AimRate * dt)
		lagPitch = math.clamp(
			lagPitch * aimDecay - turnPitch * follow,
			-SETTINGS.AimLimit,
			SETTINGS.AimLimit
		)
		lagYaw =
			math.clamp(lagYaw * aimDecay - turnYaw * follow, -SETTINGS.AimLimit, SETTINGS.AimLimit)
	end
	local state: MotionState = table.freeze({
		phase = phase,
		idlePhase = idlePhase,
		travelSpeed = travelSpeed,
		weight = weight,
		lagPitch = lagPitch,
		lagYaw = lagYaw,
	})
	local side, rise = math.sin(phase), math.cos(phase)
	local camera = cf(side * 0.014 * weight, rise * 0.022 * weight, side * 0.004 * weight)
		* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(0.14) * rise * weight, 0, math.rad(0.25) * side * weight)
	local aspect = math.clamp(number(input.aspect, 16 / 9), 0.3, 4)
	local left = -0.44 * math.clamp(aspect / 1.5, 0.48, 1)
	local breath = math.sin(idlePhase)
	local view = cf(
		left + side * 0.024 * weight + breath * 0.003,
		-0.48 + rise * 0.026 * weight + breath * 0.004,
		-1.24 + side * 0.006 * weight
	) * CFrame.Angles(
		math.rad(0.1) * rise * weight,
		0,
		math.rad(0.16) * side * weight + math.rad(0.06) * breath
	)
	return state,
		{
			view = view,
			aim = CFrame.Angles(0, lagYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(lagPitch, 0, 0),
			camera = camera,
			bobWeight = weight,
		}
end

return table.freeze(Flashlight)

--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Presentation = require(Shared:WaitForChild("FlashlightPresentation"))
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local MODEL_NAME = "CornPersonalFlashlight"
local PRE_BINDING = "CornFlashlightCameraBase"
local POST_BINDING = "CornFlashlightPresentation"
local ACTION = "CornFlashlightToggle"
local Controller = { Name = "FlashlightController", Order = 98 }
local PHASES = {
	ready = true,
	preparing = true,
	active = true,
	caught = true,
	escaped = true,
	aborted = true,
	caught_out = true,
}
local TERMINAL = { escaped = true, aborted = true, caught_out = true }
local ATTRIBUTES = { CornFlashlightOwned = true, corn_project_id = PROJECT, FlashlightVersion = 1 }

local function finite(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge
end

local function frameValid(value: any): boolean
	if typeof(value) ~= "CFrame" then
		return false
	end
	for _, component in { value:GetComponents() } do
		if not finite(component) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function ownedAttributes(item: Instance): boolean
	local attributes = item:GetAttributes()
	for name, value in ATTRIBUTES do
		if attributes[name] ~= value then
			return false
		end
	end
	for name in attributes do
		if ATTRIBUTES[name] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function recordMatches(record: any): boolean
	local item = record.item
	if
		item.ClassName ~= record.class
		or item.Name ~= record.name
		or item.Parent ~= record.parent
		or not ownedAttributes(item)
		or #item:GetTags() ~= 0
	then
		return false
	end
	for property, value in record.properties do
		if item[property] ~= value then
			return false
		end
	end
	local children = item:GetChildren()
	if #children ~= #record.children then
		return false
	end
	for _, child in children do
		if not table.find(record.children, child) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function skin(character: Model): Color3
	for _, name in { "LeftHand", "Left Arm", "LeftLowerArm" } do
		local part = character:FindFirstChild(name)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			return part.Color
		end
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(191, 145, 110)
end

function Controller:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self._roundId = -1
	self._endedRound = nil
	self._on = true
	self._focused = true
	self._visual = nil
	self._visualCamera = nil
	self._character = nil
	self._records = {}
	self._parts = {}
	self._lights = {}
	self._effect = nil
	self._lastBase = nil
	self._lastPosition = nil
	self._state = Presentation.NewState()
	self._connections = {}
	self._started = false
	self._bound = false
	self._actionBound = false
	self._movement = nil
	self._minimap = nil
	self._capture = nil
end

-- Only remove our own last additive result. A new mouse-look or capture frame
-- belongs to its writer and must never be inverted or replaced here.
function Controller:_unapplyCamera()
	local effect = self._effect
	self._effect = nil
	if
		effect
		and effect.camera.CFrame == effect.result
		and effect.camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom
		and effect.camera.CameraSubject == effect.subject
		and effect.camera:GetAttribute("CornCaptureCameraOwner") == nil
	then
		effect.camera.CFrame = effect.base
	end
end

function Controller:_visualOwned(): boolean
	if not self._visual then
		return false
	end
	for _, record in self._records do
		if not recordMatches(record) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_clearVisual()
	local model = self._visual
	if model then
		if self:_visualOwned() then
			model:Destroy()
		else
			-- An inserted foreign child must survive. Quench only the still-exact
			-- light instances we created under the unchanged original container.
			if
				model.ClassName == "Model"
				and model.Name == MODEL_NAME
				and model.Parent == self._visualCamera
				and ownedAttributes(model)
			then
				for _, record in self._lights do
					if recordMatches(record) and record.parent.Parent == model then
						record.item.Enabled = false
					end
				end
			end
			warn("[FlashlightController] Changed personal flashlight preserved")
		end
	end
	self._visual, self._visualCamera, self._character = nil, nil, nil
	self._records, self._parts, self._lights = {}, {}, {}
end

function Controller:_suspend()
	self:_unapplyCamera()
	self:_clearVisual()
	self._lastBase, self._lastPosition = nil, nil
	self._state = Presentation.NewState()
end

function Controller:_unbind()
	if self._bound then
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(PRE_BINDING)
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(POST_BINDING)
		self._bound = false
	end
end

function Controller:Clear(_reason: string?)
	self._snapshot = nil
	self:_suspend()
	self:_unbind()
end

function Controller:_livingCharacter(): (Model?, Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return character, humanoid, root
	end
	return nil, nil, nil
end

function Controller:_eligible(camera: Camera?, humanoid: Humanoid?): boolean
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	return self._snapshot ~= nil
		and self._snapshot.phase == "active"
		and self._endedRound ~= self._roundId
		and map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "A"
		and camera ~= nil
		and humanoid ~= nil
		and camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Custom
		and camera.CameraSubject == humanoid
		and camera:GetAttribute("CornCaptureCameraOwner") == nil
		and player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		and self._focused
		and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		and UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() == nil
		and not (self._movement and (self._movement._cursorOpen or self._movement._mapOpen))
		and not (self._minimap and self._minimap._expanded)
		and not (self._capture and self._capture._state.active)
end

function Controller:_buildVisual(camera: Camera, character: Model): boolean
	if camera:FindFirstChild(MODEL_NAME) then
		return false
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	local records, parts, lights = {}, {}, {}
	local created = { model }
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local function track(item: Instance, name: string, parent: Instance?, properties: any): any
			if item ~= model then
				table.insert(created, item)
			end
			item.Name = name
			for key, value in ATTRIBUTES do
				item:SetAttribute(key, value)
			end
			local observed = {}
			for key, value in properties do
				item[key] = value
				observed[key] = item[key]
			end
			item.Parent = parent
			local record = {
				item = item,
				name = name,
				class = item.ClassName,
				parent = parent,
				properties = observed,
				children = {},
			}
			table.insert(records, record)
			return record
		end
		track(model, MODEL_NAME, nil, {})
		local definitions = Presentation.Definitions()
		assert(#definitions + 1 <= Presentation.MaxParts, "Flashlight exceeds bounded geometry")
		local function part(
			name: string,
			size: Vector3,
			frame: CFrame,
			color: Color3,
			material: Enum.Material,
			shape: Enum.PartType?,
			transparency: number
		): any
			local record = track(Instance.new("Part"), name, model, {
				Size = size,
				CFrame = frame,
				Color = color,
				Material = material,
				Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block,
				Transparency = transparency,
				LocalTransparencyModifier = 0,
				Anchored = true,
				CanCollide = false,
				CanTouch = false,
				CanQuery = false,
				CastShadow = false,
			})
			record.localFrame = frame
			table.insert(parts, record)
			return record
		end
		for _, definition in definitions do
			part(
				definition.name,
				definition.size,
				definition.localFrame,
				if definition.isHand then skin(character) else definition.color,
				definition.material,
				definition.shape,
				0
			)
		end
		local emitter = part(
			"Emitter",
			Vector3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08),
			Presentation.LensFrame,
			Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			nil,
			1
		)
		for _, name in { "main", "fill" } do
			local spec = Presentation.Settings.Lights[name]
			local record = track(Instance.new("SpotLight"), name, emitter.item, {
				Face = Enum.NormalId.Front,
				Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
				Range = spec.range,
				Angle = spec.angle,
				Brightness = spec.brightness,
				Shadows = spec.shadows,
				Enabled = self._on,
			})
			table.insert(lights, record)
		end
		for _, record in records do
			record.children = record.item:GetChildren()
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		for index = #created, 1, -1 do
			created[index]:Destroy()
		end
		warn("[FlashlightController] Personal flashlight creation failed: " .. tostring(problem))
		return false
	end
	records[1].parent = camera
	self._visual, self._visualCamera, self._character = model, camera, character
	self._records, self._parts, self._lights = records, parts, lights
	model.Parent = camera
	return true
end

function Controller:_step(dt: number): boolean
	self:_unapplyCamera()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local character, humanoid, root = self:_livingCharacter()
	if not self:_eligible(camera, humanoid) then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	if self._visual and (self._visualCamera ~= camera or self._character ~= character) then
		self:_suspend()
	end
	if self._visual and not self:_visualOwned() then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	if not self._visual and not self:_buildVisual(camera :: Camera, character :: Model) then
		return false
	end
	local base = (camera :: Camera).CFrame
	if not frameValid(base) then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	local turn = Vector2.zero
	if self._lastBase then
		local pitch, yaw = self._lastBase:ToObjectSpace(base):ToOrientation()
		turn = Vector2.new(pitch, yaw)
	end
	local velocity = (root :: BasePart).AssemblyLinearVelocity
	local speed = if finite(velocity.X) and finite(velocity.Z)
		then math.sqrt(velocity.X ^ 2 + velocity.Z ^ 2)
		else 0
	local position = (root :: BasePart).Position
	local viewport = (camera :: Camera).ViewportSize
	local state, output = Presentation.Step(self._state, dt, {
		speed = speed,
		grounded = (humanoid :: Humanoid).FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air,
		turn = turn,
		aspect = if viewport.Y > 0 then viewport.X / viewport.Y else 16 / 9,
		teleported = self._lastPosition ~= nil and (position - self._lastPosition).Magnitude > 32,
	})
	if
		type(output) ~= "table"
		or not frameValid(output.camera)
		or not frameValid(output.aim)
		or not frameValid(output.view)
	then
		self:_suspend()
		return false
	end
	self._state, self._lastBase, self._lastPosition = state, base, position
	local rendered = base * output.camera
	if output.camera ~= CFrame.identity then
		(camera :: Camera).CFrame = rendered
		self._effect =
			{ camera = camera, base = base, result = (camera :: Camera).CFrame, subject = humanoid }
	end
	local frame = rendered * output.aim * output.view
	for _, record in self._parts do
		record.item.CFrame = frame * record.localFrame
		record.properties.CFrame = record.item.CFrame
	end
	for _, record in self._lights do
		record.item.Enabled = self._on
		record.properties.Enabled = self._on
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_bind()
	if self._started and not self._bound then
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(PRE_BINDING, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function()
			self:_unapplyCamera()
		end)
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(
			POST_BINDING,
			Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
			function(dt: number)
				self:_step(dt)
			end
		)
		self._bound = true
	end
end

function Controller:SetSnapshot(snapshot: any)
	if
		type(snapshot) ~= "table"
		or type(snapshot.minimap) ~= "table"
		or not PHASES[snapshot.phase]
	then
		self:Clear("malformed")
		return
	end
	local id = snapshot.minimap.round_id
	if not finite(id) or id < 0 or id % 1 ~= 0 or id < self._roundId then
		return
	end
	if id == self._roundId and self._endedRound == id and snapshot.phase == "active" then
		return
	end
	if id ~= self._roundId then
		self:Clear("new round")
		self._roundId, self._endedRound, self._on = id, nil, true
	end
	if TERMINAL[snapshot.phase] then
		self._endedRound = id
	end
	if snapshot.phase ~= "active" then
		self:Clear(snapshot.phase)
		return
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if not map or map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") ~= "A" then
		self:Clear("variant")
		return
	end
	self._snapshot = { phase = snapshot.phase }
	self:_bind()
	self:_step(0)
end

function Controller:Start(context: any)
	self._movement = context.Controllers.MovementController
	self._minimap = context.Controllers.MinimapController
	self._capture = context.Controllers.CaptureController
	self._started = true
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(ACTION, function(_, state: Enum.UserInputState)
		if state ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		if not self:_step(0) then
			return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
		end
		self._on = not self._on
		self:_step(0)
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
	end, false, 3000, Enum.KeyCode.F)
	self._actionBound = true
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(function()
			self:_suspend()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
			self._focused = false
			self:_suspend()
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		UserInputService.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
			self._focused = true
		end)
	)
	for _, signal in { player.CharacterAdded, player.CharacterRemoving } do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			signal:Connect(function()
				self:Clear("character changed")
			end)
		)
	end
	if self._snapshot then
		self:_bind()
	end
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self:Clear("destroy")
	if self._actionBound then
		ContextActionService:UnbindAction(ACTION)
		self._actionBound = false
	end
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._connections)
	self._started = false
	self._movement, self._minimap, self._capture = nil, nil, nil
end

return Controller

--!strict

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameShared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
local EndpointNames = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Network"):WaitForChild("EndpointNames"))
local LightingModes = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("LightingModes"))
local MinimapGeometry = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("MinimapGeometry"))
local Inventory = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("Inventory"))
local Capture = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CapturePresentation"))
local RoundHud = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("RoundHud"))

type Snapshot = RoundHud.Snapshot

local RoundController = {
	Name = "RoundController",
	Order = 100,
	_snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?,
	_requestRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?,
	_snapshotConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	_lastRequest = -math.huge,
	_hud = nil :: any,
}

local PHASES: { [string]: boolean } = {
	ready = true,
	preparing = true,
	active = true,
	escaped = true,
	aborted = true,
	caught = true,
	caught_out = true,
}
local ACTIONS: { [string]: boolean } = {
	start = true,
	retry = true,
	abort = true,
	menu = true,
	revive = true,
}
local DEBOUNCE_SEC = 0.55
local REMOTE_WAIT_SEC = 10

local function nonnegativeNumber(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= 0 and value < math.huge
end

local function boundedInteger(value: any, maximum: number): boolean
	return nonnegativeNumber(value) and value % 1 == 0 and value <= maximum
end

local function validTeam(value: any): boolean
	return value == nil
		or (
			typeof(value) == "table"
			and boundedInteger(value.round_id, 9007199254740991)
			and typeof(value.state) == "string"
			and ({ waiting = true, preparing = true, active = true, finished = true })[value.state] == true
			and value.capacity == 4
			and boundedInteger(value.count, value.capacity)
			and boundedInteger(value.ready_count, value.count)
			and boundedInteger(value.remaining, value.count)
			and typeof(value.ready) == "boolean"
			and typeof(value.can_start) == "boolean"
			and typeof(value.key_state) == "string"
			and ({ hidden = true, carried = true, opened = true })[value.key_state] == true
			and typeof(value.carrier_name) == "string"
			and #value.carrier_name <= 50
		)
end

local function validSnapshot(value: any): boolean
	return typeof(value) == "table"
		and validTeam(value.team)
		and LightingModes.IsValid(value.lighting_mode)
		and MinimapGeometry.IsValid(value.minimap)
		and Inventory.IsValidSnapshot(value.inventory)
		and Capture.IsValidSnapshot(value.capture)
		and typeof(value.phase) == "string"
		and PHASES[value.phase] == true
		and (value.phase == "caught" or value.capture.remaining == 0)
		and typeof(value.has_key) == "boolean"
		and typeof(value.gate_open) == "boolean"
		and (value.evacuation == nil or (typeof(value.evacuation) == "table" and typeof(
			value.evacuation.active
		) == "boolean" and value.evacuation.duration == 120 and nonnegativeNumber(
			value.evacuation.remaining
		) and value.evacuation.remaining <= 120 and (value.evacuation.active or value.evacuation.remaining == 0)))
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.session_diamonds)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.reward_diamonds)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.elapsed_sec)
		and typeof(value.notice) == "string"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.stamina)
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.stamina_capacity)
		and value.stamina_capacity > 0
		and value.stamina <= value.stamina_capacity
		and typeof(value.is_sprinting) == "boolean"
		and typeof(value.sprint_exhausted) == "boolean"
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.catches_remaining)
		and value.catches_remaining <= 2
		and value.catches_remaining % 1 == 0
		and typeof(value.monster_state) == "string"
		and ({
			dormant = true,
			patrol = true,
			chase = true,
			stopped = true,
			trapped = true,
			capturing = true,
		})[value.monster_state] == true
		and nonnegativeNumber(value.protection_sec)
		and typeof(value.start_look) == "Vector3"
		and value.start_look.Magnitude > 0.99
		and value.start_look.Magnitude < 1.01
		and math.abs(value.start_look.Y) < 0.001
end

local function getRemote(folder: Instance, name: string): RemoteEvent?
	local instance = folder:WaitForChild(name, REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not instance or not instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		warn(
			string.format(
				"[RoundController] RemoteEvent %s is unavailable after %ds",
				name,
				REMOTE_WAIT_SEC
			)
		)
		return nil
	end
	return instance
end

function RoundController:Init(_context: any)
	self._snapshot = nil :: Snapshot?
	self._requestRemote = nil :: RemoteEvent?
	self._snapshotConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?
	self._lastRequest = -math.huge
	self._hud = nil

	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not playerGui or not playerGui:IsA("PlayerGui") then
		warn("[RoundController] PlayerGui is unavailable; the round interface was not created")
		return
	end
	self._hud = RoundHud.new(playerGui)
	self._hud:SetOnAction(function(action: string, mode: string?)
		self:_request(action, mode)
	end)
end

function RoundController:_request(action: string, mode: string?)
	local remote = self._requestRemote
	local hud = self._hud
	if
		not remote
		or not hud
		or hud._unavailable
		or not self._snapshot
		or ACTIONS[action] ~= true
	then
		return
	end
	if (action == "start" or action == "retry") and not LightingModes.IsValid(mode) then
		return
	end
	local team = self._snapshot.team
	if (action == "start" or action == "retry") and team and (team.ready or not team.can_start) then
		return
	end
	if action == "start" and self._snapshot.phase ~= "ready" then
		return
	end
	if
		action == "revive"
		and (
			mode ~= nil
			or self._snapshot.phase ~= "caught"
			or self._snapshot.capture.remaining ~= 0
			or self._snapshot.catches_remaining ~= 1
			or hud._captureActive
		)
	then
		return
	end
	if
		action == "retry"
		and self._snapshot.phase ~= "escaped"
		and self._snapshot.phase ~= "aborted"
		and self._snapshot.phase ~= "caught_out"
	then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - self._lastRequest < DEBOUNCE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._lastRequest = now
	hud:SetBusy(true)
	remote:FireServer(action, mode)
	-- Only the server changes the view. A rejected request must not leave buttons stuck.
	task.delay(DEBOUNCE_SEC, function()
		if self._hud == hud then
			hud:SetBusy(false)
		end
	end)
end

function RoundController:Start(context: any)
	local hud = self._hud
	if not hud then
		return
	end
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameRemotes", REMOTE_WAIT_SEC)
	if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
		warn("[RoundController] GameRemotes is unavailable; check RoundService startup in Output")
		hud:ShowUnavailable()
		return
	end
	local requestRemote = getRemote(folder, EndpointNames.RequestRoundAction)
	local snapshotRemote = getRemote(folder, EndpointNames.RoundSnapshot)
	if not requestRemote or not snapshotRemote then
		hud:ShowUnavailable()
		return
	end
	self._requestRemote = requestRemote
	self._snapshotConnection = snapshotRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload: any)
		if not validSnapshot(payload) then
			self._snapshot = nil
			hud:ShowUnavailable()
			context.Controllers.CaptureController:Cancel("malformed snapshot")
			context.Controllers.HandheldController:Clear("malformed snapshot")
			context.Controllers.FlashlightController:Clear("malformed snapshot")
			context.Controllers.AudioController:Clear("malformed snapshot")
			warn("[RoundController] Ignored a malformed round_snapshot")
			return
		end
		self._snapshot = payload :: Snapshot
		context.Controllers.CaptureController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		hud:Render(payload :: Snapshot)
		context.Controllers.MovementController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.MinimapController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.InventoryController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.HandheldController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.FlashlightController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.AudioController:SetSnapshot(payload)
		context.Controllers.CornController:SetLightingMode(
			if payload.phase == "ready" then nil else payload.lighting_mode
		)
		local cornMode = if payload.phase == "ready" then nil else payload.lighting_mode
		context.Controllers.CornAppearanceController:SetMode(cornMode)
		context.Controllers.CornWindController:SetMode(cornMode)
		context.Controllers.GateHintController:SetSnapshot(payload)
	end)

	-- Subscribe first: initial server messages may precede the client controller.
	requestRemote:FireServer("sync")
	task.delay(2, function()
		if self._hud == hud and self._snapshot == nil then
			requestRemote:FireServer("sync")
		end
	end)
	task.delay(REMOTE_WAIT_SEC, function()
		if self._hud == hud and self._snapshot == nil then
			warn("[RoundController] No valid initial round_snapshot; check RoundService Output")
			hud:ShowUnavailable()
		end
	end)
end

function RoundController:Destroy()
	if self._snapshotConnection then
		self._snapshotConnection:Disconnect()
		self._snapshotConnection = nil
	end
	if self._hud then
		self._hud:Destroy()
		self._hud = nil
	end
	self._requestRemote = nil
	self._snapshot = nil
end

return RoundController
